scenes.after:

task | owner | due date
Then one line on anything still undecided.
scenes.title: Same notes. *Usable*.
Name the *format*
scenes.body: Table, checklist, JSON, 3 bullets. It'll match it.

scenes.title: List the *fields*
scenes.body: If you know the columns you need, say them. No more reformatting.

end.title: Save this *one*
end.sub: follow for daily AI + code tips

caption:
If you don't say what shape you want, you get a wall of text.

Name the format (table, checklist, JSON, 3 bullets) and, if you know them, the exact fields. "Table: task | owner | due date" turns a meeting summary into something you can actually use.

Save this for your next meeting.
